sources.fact: Authoritative current Brownfield entity is LBBD95/WC at Selinas Lane.
The record gives 150 minimum and maximum net dwellings on 0.62ha.
The structured planning-permission-status field is permissioned.
The same record notes 'No decision taken on planning application'; the structured status and note are retained as an unresolved source conflict.
Ownership-status is not-owned-by-a-public-authority and is not a named proprietor/title relation.
The record supplies a point and blank geometry, not exact parcel geometry.
22/01424/FULL at Dairy Crest, Chadwell House, Selinas Lane concerned demolition and construction of industrial buildings, not a 150-home residential approval.
The 2022 Committee delegated grant subject to S106 and a deadline; it is not transferred to the WC residential status.
A separate former Muller Factory Selinas Lane case concerned temporary B8/open-storage and car-dealership use.
The 2022 Cabinet record describes disposal of the former Muller dairy site and industrial/mixed-use promotion context, not residential permission finality.
Older Selinas Lane place-of-worship permission demonstrates same-street address collision and is not applied to WC.
No exact issued residential decision resolving the WC status/note conflict or HMLR topology was verified this wave.

examples.result: WC retains 150 dwellings from the current authoritative record.
Permissioned field and no-decision note remain visibly conflicted.
The industrial Dairy Crest application is not residential permission evidence.
Temporary storage/car-dealership use is not transferred to WC housing status.
Same-street worship permission is blocked by address-collision rules.
Disposal and promotion strategy are not issued planning permission.
Point and ownership category are not title geometry or proprietor proof.
Promotion remains zero until the exact residential decision and title relation are verified.

candidate_summary.record_note: No decision taken on planning application
